website_summary.name: SportsRecruit Platform
website_summary.description: The website presents a clean and professional login interface with a minimalist design, featuring a simple form for user authentication against a ghost white backdrop.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a minimalist and modern design with a ghost white background and slate gray UI elements. The central focus is a login card with rounded corners and a subtle shadow effect, enhancing its prominence. Inside the card, there are two input fields labeled "Username" and "Password," followed by a prominent "Login" button with a dark slate gray background. Below the login button, there is a link prompting users who don't have an account to register. The overall layout is centered on the screen, ensuring a balanced and visually appealing composition.
website_summary.functionality: The website provides essential functionalities for user authentication. It includes a login form where users can enter their credentials to access their accounts. Additionally, there is a registration link for new users who wish to create an account. While the screenshot only shows the login page, the platform likely supports broader functionalities such as athlete registration, job posting, job application, and message notifications, as per the given instructions.

functionality_testing.name: Login Action Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the Login Button processes the login form submission and leads to successful navigation given valid credentials.
functionality_testing.preconditions: Both username and password fields are filled with valid entries.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The system would validate the username and password, and upon successful verification, navigate the user to the job listings page.

functionality_testing.name: Password Field Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the Password Field textbox functions correctly.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The password field should accept and display the entered text accurately, masking the characters for security.
procedure: Verify that the input is accepted and displayed correctly (usually masked).

functionality_testing.name: Register Link Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Register Link redirects to the registration page.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The user is redirected to the registration page. 7. Next Steps : Click on the "Don't have an account? Register" link to proceed with the task.
procedure: Verify that the page redirects to the registration page.

functionality_testing.name: Username Field Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the Username Field textbox functions correctly.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The username field should accept and display the entered text accurately.
procedure: Verify that the input is accepted and displayed correctly.

functionality_testing.name: Test Posting a New Job Listing
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the 'Post a Job' button functions correctly and navigates to the job posting form.
functionality_testing.coverage_element: Post a Job Button : Button for posting a new job listing
functionality_testing.preconditions: User is logged in and has access to post jobs.
functionality_testing.expected_results: Upon clicking the 'Post a Job' button, the user should be redirected to the job posting form page.
procedure: Step 1 : Log in as a user with permission to post jobs.
Step 2 : Click on the 'Post a Job' button and verify redirection to the job posting form.

functionality_testing.name: Test Login Link Functionality
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the 'Login' link directs users to the login page.
functionality_testing.coverage_element: Login Link : Link for users with an account to log in
functionality_testing.expected_results: Upon clicking the 'Login' link, the user should be redirected to the login page.
procedure: Step 1 : Ensure the user is currently not logged into the application.
Step 2 : Click on the 'Login' link and verify redirection to the login page.

data_display_testing.name: Test Display of Job Listings Card
data_display_testing.objective: To verify that the job listings card displays all relevant information correctly.
data_display_testing.coverage_element: Job Listings Card : Card containing the job listings and related elements
data_display_testing.preconditions: Job listings exist in the database.
data_display_testing.expected_results: The job listings card should display all job listings with their titles, descriptions, and other related details accurately.
procedure: Step 1 : Ensure there are job listings available in the system.
Step 2 : Navigate to the page containing the job listings card and verify that all information is displayed correctly.

design_validation_testing.name: UI Design and Style Test: Color Palette
design_validation_testing.objective: To evaluate the color consistency and contrast of the login card and its elements.
design_validation_testing.expected_results: The login card and its elements should maintain consistent colors with the specified theme, ensuring good contrast and readability.
procedure: Observe the color scheme of the login card and its elements.
Compare the colors against the specified ghost white background and slate gray theme.
Assess the contrast and visual hierarchy.
